result.title: Compressible Representations: Functional Spines in Deep Neural Networks
result.summary: Deep networks embed inputs in high-dimensional representations, but how much of this capacity actually drives behavior? We introduce a framework for identifying, at each layer, the subspace of the representation that is functionally sensitive to the task. Using a matrix analogous to the Fisher information but defined over the hidden representation, we rank directions by their influence on downstream computation and project onto the most task-sensitive subspace. Across pretrained vision networks, representations are remarkably compressible: a small fraction of the task-sensitive subspace preserves most performance, often requiring far fewer dimensions than geometric alternatives. We find that this compressed representation is also more robust to adversarial attacks generated on the full network. We additionally show that this decomposition recovers functionally distinct subspaces within the same representation: on cue-conflict stimuli, shape-sensitive and texture-sensitive directions are largely non-overlapping, and ablating one selectively impairs the corresponding task while leaving the other intact. Task-sensitive subspaces also provide a principled foundation for continual learning: constraining gradient updates to lie orthogonal to the task-sensitive subspaces of prior tasks outperforms standard variance-based gradient projection methods. Finally, restricting representational comparisons to task-sensitive subspaces reveals that inter-model alignment is higher in task-sensitive directions than in task-insensitive directions at later layers, and that conditioning on different tasks over the same stimuli uncovers asymmetries that full-space similarity measures cannot detect. Together, these results establish that deep networks compute through a low-dimensional functional spine embedded within a much larger representational space.

AI.brief_summary: 提出用隐表示上的 Fisher 类矩阵衡量各方向对下游计算的影响，逐层识别任务敏感子空间并投影压缩；在预训练视觉网络上显示少量维度即可保留大部分性能，且该子空间支撑对抗鲁棒、shape/texture 子空间分离、持续学习与跨模型对齐分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对表示方向的“功能敏感性”排序与定向消融，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 内容是否真正被答案使用、以及只在高功能方向比较 latent 相似度（涉及深度与位置效应）提供可核查工具，但在多模态推理状态上的适用性尚待验证。
